name: nfe_entries_and_stock_receipts
query: create table if not exists public.nfe_entries (id bigint generated by default as identity primary key, access_key text not null unique check (access_key ~ '^[0-9]{44}$'), invoice_number text not null, series text, issue_date timestamptz, supplier_name text not null, supplier_document text, total_amount numeric(14,2) not null default 0 check (total_amount >= 0), imported_by bigint references public.users(id) on delete set null, imported_at timestamptz not null default now()); create table if not exists public.nfe_entry_items (id bigint generated by default as identity primary key, nfe_entry_id bigint not null references public.nfe_entries(id) on delete cascade, product_id bigint not null references public.products(id) on delete restrict, product_code text not null, barcode text, product_name text not null, unit text not null check (unit in ('un','kg')), quantity numeric(14,3) not null check (quantity > 0), unit_cost numeric(14,2) not null check (unit_cost >= 0), line_total numeric(14,2) not null check (line_total >= 0)); create index if not exists nfe_entry_items_entry_idx on public.nfe_entry_items(nfe_entry_id); create index if not exists nfe_entry_items_product_idx on public.nfe_entry_items(product_id); alter table public.nfe_entries enable row level security; alter table public.nfe_entry_items enable row level security; revoke all on table public.nfe_entries, public.nfe_entry_items from anon, authenticated; alter table public.stock_movements add column if not exists nfe_entry_id bigint references public.nfe_entries(id) on delete set null; alter table public.stock_movements drop constraint if exists stock_movements_movement_type_check; alter table public.stock_movements add constraint stock_movements_movement_type_check check (movement_type in ('manual_adjustment','nfe_entry')); create or replace function public.import_nfe_entry(p_access_key text, p_invoice_number text, p_series text, p_issue_date timestamptz, p_supplier_name text, p_supplier_document text, p_total_amount numeric, p_user_id bigint, p_items jsonb) returns jsonb language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public as $$ declare v_entry_id bigint; v_item jsonb; v_product_id bigint; v_previous numeric(14,3); v_resulting numeric(14,3); v_created integer := 0; v_updated integer := 0; v_unit text; v_qty numeric(14,3); v_cost numeric(14,2); v_sale numeric(14,2); v_code text; v_name text; v_barcode text; begin if p_access_key !~ '^[0-9]{44}$' then raise exception 'Chave de acesso inválida'; end if; if exists (select 1 from nfe_entries where access_key = p_access_key limit 1) then raise exception 'Esta NF-e já foi importada'; end if; if p_items is null or jsonb_array_length(p_items) = 0 then raise exception 'A NF-e precisa possuir ao menos um item'; end if; insert into nfe_entries(access_key, invoice_number, series, issue_date, supplier_name, supplier_document, total_amount, imported_by) values (p_access_key, coalesce(nullif(trim(p_invoice_number),''),'Sem número'), nullif(trim(p_series),''), p_issue_date, coalesce(nullif(trim(p_supplier_name),''),'Fornecedor não informado'), nullif(trim(p_supplier_document),''), round(coalesce(p_total_amount,0),2), p_user_id) returning id into v_entry_id; for v_item in select * from jsonb_array_elements(p_items) loop v_product_id := nullif(v_item->>'productId','')::bigint; v_code := coalesce(nullif(trim(v_item->>'productCode'),''),'NF-E'); v_name := coalesce(nullif(trim(v_item->>'name'),''),'Produto da NF-e'); v_barcode := nullif(trim(v_item->>'barcode'),''); v_unit := coalesce(v_item->>'unit','un'); v_qty := round((v_item->>'quantity')::numeric,3); v_cost := round((v_item->>'unitCost')::numeric,2); v_sale := round((v_item->>'salePrice')::numeric,2); if v_qty <= 0 or v_cost < 0 or v_unit not in ('un','kg') then raise exception 'Item inválido na NF-e: %', v_code; end if; if v_product_id is null then insert into products(name, cost_price, sale_price, unit, stock_current, stock_minimum, inventory_code, barcode, active) values(v_name, v_cost, greatest(v_sale,0.01), v_unit, 0, 0, v_code, v_barcode, true) returning id into v_product_id; v_created := v_created + 1; else select stock_current, unit into v_previous, v_unit from products where id = v_product_id and active = true for update; if not found then raise exception 'Produto associado não encontrado: %', v_code; end if; if v_unit <> (v_item->>'unit') then raise exception 'Unidade incompatível no item: %', v_code; end if; v_updated := v_updated + 1; end if; update products set stock_current = round(stock_current + v_qty,3), cost_price = v_cost, updated_at = now() where id = v_product_id returning stock_current into v_resulting; insert into nfe_entry_items(nfe_entry_id, product_id, product_code, barcode, product_name, unit, quantity, unit_cost, line_total) values(v_entry_id, v_product_id, v_code, v_barcode, v_name, v_unit, v_qty, v_cost, round(v_qty*v_cost,2)); insert into stock_movements(product_id, movement_type, previous_quantity, adjustment_quantity, resulting_quantity, reason, created_by, nfe_entry_id) values(v_product_id,'nfe_entry',coalesce(v_previous,0),v_qty,v_resulting,concat('Entrada NF-e ',p_access_key),p_user_id,v_entry_id); end loop; return jsonb_build_object('entryId',v_entry_id,'createdProducts',v_created,'updatedProducts',v_updated); exception when others then raise; end; $$; revoke all on function public.import_nfe_entry(text,text,text,timestamptz,text,text,numeric,bigint,jsonb) from public, anon, authenticated; grant execute on function public.import_nfe_entry(text,text,text,timestamptz,text,text,numeric,bigint,jsonb) to service_role;
